summary.headline: Watery Triplicity Omens
summary.text: Astrological forecasts for Saturn–Moon conjunctions in the watery triplicity, especially Aquarius, Cancer, and Scorpio, covering winds, rain, disease, war, travel, agriculture, and social unrest. Elevated Saturn or Moon brings distinct effects, including severity in Armenia and Babylon and turmoil among rulers and common people.
